explanation: Draw a uniform real number in [0,1), then subtract consecutive probability masses until the draw lies in one value’s interval. A persistent random engine avoids reseeding each draw. The wrapper retains one million trials, the original five-standard-deviation bounds and retry behavior.
timeComplexity: O(n) worst-case time per weighted draw; one million statistical draws per wrapper trial.
spaceComplexity: O(1) algorithm workspace, plus O(n) wrapper frequency counts.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed weighted-random contract and repository-authored C# algorithm. The existing million-draw statistical protocol and 5σ acceptance bounds are preserved. No upstream reference implementation was modified.
